_what_this_is: This Product's capability registry (G14.3, STD-CAPABILITY-REGISTRY-001): every external capability its code reaches for, the key it needs, and whether using it sends data off this machine. Written 2026-10-21 for the Factory development layer.

capabilities.install_command: docker compose up -d postgres  # compose.yaml: image postgres:17
capabilities.notes: The system of record. MASTERBRAIN_DSN (src/masterbrain) and EMAIL_BRAIN_DSN (src/email_brain/cli.py) name the same local server; a DSN carries a password, so it lives outside the checkout (.env.example says so). Tests need a disposable email_brain_test* database (README).

src/email_brain/connectors/fastmail.py. Reads the owner's own mailbox: mail flows FROM the provider, only the token goes to it. Any change to the mailbox is an approved, auditable command, never a model-generated write (PRODUCT.md).
src/email_brain/connectors/gmail.py; OAuth credentials file, outside the checkout.

capabilities.install_command: brew install tesseract  # the worker pins tesseract 5.5.0 and a pytesseract version
capabilities.notes: src/masterbrain/datacore/image_ocr_worker.py refuses any tesseract other than 5.5.0, so OCR output is reproducible across machines.

internal_env.CW_BINDING_TOKEN: (the Factory's declaration) the Factory/Product session-binding token (SESSION_CONTRACT.md §2) — internal plumbing, not an external capability
